basis: Resident deployment (host A800I-03 = ssh npu2, 8x Ascend 910B4-1 64 GB) of the port's Thinking BF16 fragment on host 181: four instances x tensor-parallel 2, deployed once and left up (owner decision 2026-10-28). REVISION v2 (DRAFT, pending the owner's answer to Q-B, plan 3.9 decision 4): max_num_seqs 32 is the resident scheduling CEILING, equal to the admitted crash-safe level (32 per instance, zero worst-case preemptions); excess requests queue instead of preempting, which turns the client-concurrency rule into an engine-enforced bound. It is a deployment fact (outside protocol_sha256) and changes the graph capture sizes, so the KV per card is re-read from the startup line. The sampled waiting gauge must read 0 at the recorded level 32. Each experiment's client concurrency comes from the synthetic sweep's knee (scripts/serving/synthetic_sweep.py) and stays below it. cpusets pin each instance to its own cards' PCI NUMA node(s) read on 181 (2026-10-28: NPU 0-1 node 6 = 192-223, 2-3 node 4 = 128-159, 4-5 node 0 = 0-31, 6-7 node 2 = 64-95; 32 cores per node). The other 128 cores (nodes 1/3/5/7) stay free for the flight harness and CPU encoder runs on the same host. HCCL_IF_BASE_PORT is distinct per instance because all four share the host network namespace (defensive; unverified on NPU).
